q: A firm's net sales are ₹2,00,000 and its gross profit is ₹50,000. What is its gross profit ratio?
Which accounting concept is summed up by the rule 'anticipate no profit, but provide for all possible losses'?
e: This cautious rule is the Prudence (conservatism) concept.

q: A firm has current assets of ₹1,20,000 (including inventory of ₹40,000) and current liabilities of ₹50,000. What is its quick (liquid) ratio?
Which sorting algorithm has a worst-case time complexity of O(n log n) and sorts in place using only O(1) extra space?
e: Heap sort runs in O(n log n) even in the worst case and needs only constant extra space.

q: In SQL, which clause is used to apply a condition to the groups produced by GROUP BY?
e: The HAVING clause filters groups after aggregation (e.g. HAVING COUNT(*) > 2).

q: What is the modulus of the complex number z = 3 + 4i?
What is the solution of the differential equation dy/dx = y that satisfies y(0) = 2?
e: Separating variables gives y = Ceˣ; the condition y(0) = 2 gives C = 2, so y = 2eˣ.

q: In how many ways can 4 letters be put into their 4 addressed envelopes (one letter per envelope) so that no letter goes into its correct envelope?
What is the SI unit of self-inductance?
e: Inductance is measured in the Henry (1 H = 1 Wb/A).

q: An ideal step-up transformer has 100 turns in its primary coil and 500 turns in its secondary coil. If 220 V AC is applied to the primary, what is the secondary voltage?
The charge carried by one mole of electrons (the Faraday constant) is approximately:
e: 1 faraday = charge of one mole of electrons ≈ 96,500 C.

q: What is the geometry of nickel tetracarbonyl, [Ni(CO)₄]?
e: Ni(0) is sp³ hybridised in [Ni(CO)₄], so the complex is Tetrahedral.

q: Which cell organelle is often called the 'suicide bag' of the cell?
e: The Lysosome contains hydrolytic enzymes that can digest the cell itself.

q: In C₄ plants, what is the first stable product of CO₂ fixation in the mesophyll cells?
e: PEP carboxylase fixes CO₂ into the 4-carbon Oxaloacetic acid (OAA), hence the name C₄.

q: The theory of comparative cost advantage in international trade was propounded by:
e: David Ricardo set out comparative advantage in 'Principles of Political Economy and Taxation' (1817).

q: In Fiedler's contingency model of leadership, the abbreviation LPC stands for:
e: Fiedler measured leadership style with the Least Preferred Co-worker (LPC) scale.
'The Prince' was written by Niccolò Machiavelli of Florence.

q: In the ideal air-standard Diesel cycle, heat is added to the working fluid at constant:
e: In the Diesel cycle heat addition takes place at constant Pressure.
